title: Construct a genuine cubic symmetry action and localize a fractional fermion doublet
completion_criterion: A new scoped proof, exact counterexample or checked partial derivation of the named obligation, with the first unresolved step and a disjoint check; known corrections or historical reports are not completion.
research_target: Advance one precise interface toward a bosonic site-local cubic code with a genuine proper-cubic O action, ordinary local excitations, and a fermionic charge with an internal representation of dimension at least two whose localized symmetry carries w2. Choose ONE new construction, exact localization lemma, compatible vacuum construction or rigorously scoped obstruction. State the full Hilbert-space group action and group law, the charge/local-operator quotient and admissible dressings, and the vacuum reference. A central extension acting nontrivially on local excitations is not a genuine O action; the supplied C15 matter-only 2O action and clean-pair signs do not solve this target. For a positive fractionalization result, construct the localized operators and prove their composition/gauge equivalence and representative invariance, including the D2 restrictions; a multiplication of pair eigenvalues alone is insufficient. For a vacuum result, distinguish an invariant code subspace or ray from a common phase-one vector for a consistently phased group representation, and state finite-volume, boundary and any infinite-volume scope. A useful exact partial result or counterexample is welcome; identify the first remaining obstruction without turning finite search failure into a universal exclusion.

Treat these as distinct residual obligations, and choose one precise advance rather than treating the supplied construction as completion.
